title: Companion rule lifecycle
description: Use a disabled validation rule created by e2e-pr-rule-actions.mts. The associated notification may already be acknowledged. Supply its IDs/names and PR_RULE_VALIDATION_ID/PR_RULE_NOTIFICATION_ID. This recipe ends with the rule disabled.

open-route.intent: A notification link opens Rules even when PR automation is already mounted.

rule-tab.intent: The native screen has reconnected to shared PR state.

filter.intent: Filter the rule inventory to the validation team.

search.intent: The operator can find a team in a long inventory.

keyboard.intent: The matching team is accessible after completing the search.

choose.intent: The chosen team determines which rule policies are displayed.

show-rule.intent: Rule lifecycle controls are reachable below the team attention card.

preview.intent: Re-enabling requires a fresh preview of current GitHub facts.

preview-ready.intent: The operator can inspect complete source coverage before activation.

enable.intent: Explicitly enable future changes without importing historical work.

verify-enabled.intent: Native activation reaches the authoritative gateway record.

disable-again.intent: Leave the validation rule disabled after exercising activation.

verify-final.intent: The final disabled state is visible through a separate client connection.

wait-control-ready.intent: Read the rendered accessibility state until activation finishes before pressing Disable. The earlier gateway broadcast can arrive while this control is still disabled.
